title: Whole-Song Hierarchical Generation of Symbolic Music Using Cascaded Diffusion Models

layout.note: Four equal stage panels in a 2x2 grid read in Z order, each with a white tab-like title box at its top-left corner, inside one thick outer frame; a full-height legend column at the right holds six headed groups of swatches. Every panel reuses one template: stack of known strips on top, context cards and noise strip in the middle, DM at the centre, output strip at the bottom.

lesson: Fix a legend of hue = level and tint = status, then repeat one identical panel per stage and stack pale strips of the upper levels behind the current strip, so cumulative conditioning shows without arrows between stages.
